query_contract.transport: fixed local subprocess, explicit SQLiteSearchRepository with read-only immutable SQLite URI; no CLI/MCP/server startup
query_contract.filesystem_writes: denied in query subprocess by Python audit hooks; SQLite mode=ro and immutable=1; model local_files_only and specific_model_path
query_contract.network: denied by subprocess Python audit hook; HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1; no external provider
query_contract.canonical_result_source: reopened allowed canonical files, never vendor metadata
